'''Deciat''' is an independent system in the Core Systems, and one of the first destinations most Commanders visit for ship Engineering. It hosts '''[[Farseer Inc]]''', the workshop of '''[[Felicity Farseer]]''', one of the two independent starting Engineers most new Commanders reach first.<ref name="inara-deciat">[https://inara.cz/elite/starsystem/2821/ Deciat — Star System], Inara.</ref>

== Overview ==

* '''Star:''' Class K (scoopable)
* '''Allegiance:''' Independent
* '''Government:''' Feudal
* '''Security:''' High
* '''Economy:''' Industrial / Refinery<ref name="inara-deciat" />

Deciat's high security rating and short distance from the starting bubble make it a low-risk trip for Commanders travelling here for the first time.

== Engineer Facility ==

'''[[Farseer Inc]]''' is a surface Engineer base on Deciat 6a, operated by '''[[Felicity Farseer]]'''.<ref name="inara-farseer-inc">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/52125/ Farseer Inc in Deciat — Station], Inara.</ref>

No system permit is required to enter Deciat. See [[Felicity Farseer]] for the full discovery, invitation, and unlock requirements for her workshop.
